player_prompt.intro:
O ni Mwene {player_id} mu nkhelo ya {num_rounds}-lupito la Mpiwa-Kapu-Tatu.
Nketo yaku ni kushinda malupito mengi iwezekanavyo.
Mu lupito lula, lingila na moja ya: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
O nawe unaweza kutumia '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' kama fupi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kuyichi ni kutayiza. Shimbu kanda uyile, shinda [rock], [paper] hanji [scissors].

message.round_win: Kuheta cha mukusoloka: Mutu yoze akulinga {winner} kakumba!

outcome.p1_wins: Mutu yoze wakutala ha 1, mwe wapwa ni uhashi wa kuheta chinji!
